final: WITH big AS (SELECT o.account_id, o.amount, d.A3 AS region FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802), g AS (SELECT account_id, region, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM big GROUP BY account_id, region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS ov FROM g) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.avg_amount, g.avg_amount - overall.ov AS diff FROM g, overall ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
